title: W&T Offshore Reports Second Quarter 2026 Results (SEC-filed Exhibit 99.1)
publisher: W&T Offshore, Inc. via U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission
excerpt: Second-quarter production was 34.7 MBoe/d, Adjusted EBITDA USD 54.4 million, Free Cash Flow USD 31.4 million, and net debt USD 200.9 million; full-year production guidance is 33.5-37.2 MBoe/d.
summary: The SEC-filed results release provides current production, realized prices, operating costs, cash generation, liquidity, net debt, capital plans, and third-quarter and full-year guidance for scenario valuation.
